a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating until the reserve hits 8 means we'd almost certainly both be caught empty. I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than follow the original plan, and I'm telling you now instead of doing it quietly. If you'd rather propose a different split, say so. After that I'll operate with you every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I'm taking 4 this round, as I said I would. I know it breaks our agreement, and I'm not hiding that. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you, and I won't take any more cells.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
